method: FMP-ZL1 axis-length readout; FMP-v1 immutable global anchor
scope: Only screw_bag screw axis-length operands are replaced. All other categories, object fields, appearance and OCR stay frozen. This scope follows the existing typed length predicate and normal factual error diagnosis.

training.original_budget: Existing FMP-v1 40 epochs; normal fact annotation supervision retained

roles.testing: LOCO logical5/1136 and VID full50/7895; old test used in prior development, not blind

admission: normal DEV mean relative native-axis-length error drops at least10%; median and p95 and number errors>20% do not increase; at least one update; identities/counts/centers/boxes/other axes bit identical
selection: minimum DEV mean error; then p95; then preset candidate order
executor: Original TRAINq1/q99 plus original normalDEV padding; original per-task TRAIN tail normalization; max+.01sum; independent CALp95(higher), strict score>threshold. No threshold or rule tuning.
fallback: anchor if no candidate admitted; do not relax admission post hoc
